customize.text:
.
<color=#ffffff>Location -</color> <color=#ece5d8>Wavechaser Plain, Nod-Krai</color>
<color=#ffffff73>This quest starts automatically after completing Wind-Stirred Ripples, revealing a quest mark that the player must head to.</color>

<color=#ffffff73>When coming close to the marked location, a voice will speak to the player.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Head to the</color> <color=#ece5d8>Pillar of Embla</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Enter the tower</color>

<color=#ffffff73>When the player approaches the tower, Wild Hunt enemies will ambush them:</color>
<color=#ffffff73>3x</color>

customize.name: Wilderness Exile
customize.desc:
A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come.
All who dwell beneath the moon set out on journeys with their own goals and wishes in mind, but not all such wishes receive favor. Spirits that cannot rest due to engendered resentment, partings with loved ones, or desires that go unfulfilled, if corrupted by the Abyss, may transform into ghouls, forever lost in the thick mists of the Wild Hunt.

customize.text: <color=#ffffff73>1x</color>

customize.name: Wilderness Hunter
customize.desc:
A ghoul that stalks the frozen wilderness when the pitch-dark mist rolls in. Their emergence presages worse calamities to come.
Many great champions of a lost ancient kingdom lie buried beneath the frozen northlands. Though the remnants of the past have been long wiped clean, these noble spirits yet defend their golden homeland. Awakened by Abyssal taint, these warriors now see all who trespass as prey.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff73>A meter called “Abyssal Corrosion” will appear on the screen. It is decreased as the player defeats the nearby Wild Hunt enemies. The Wilderness Exile will continuously respawn until the meter is depleted.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Once the Wild Hunt is dealt with, a Precious Chest and a Common Chest will spawn close by and the previously</color> <color=#ffffff73>restrained kuuhenki will open a path forward.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>To enter the tower, use the Cottonspring Flowers that can be found nearby in order to ascend to your objective.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Alternatively, the quest will proceed if the player chooses to climb the tower instead.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Clear out the monsters</color>

<color=#ffffff73>After exiting the Cottonspring Flowers, the player will be met by Abyssal enemies which must be defeated before proceeding:</color>
<color=#ffffff73>2x</color>

customize.name: Thundercraven Rifthound
customize.desc:
A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. They were created by "Gold."
Once upon a time, they ran riot across the continent, but they went extinct for a time due to resistance and mass hunts. Recently, however, they have re-emerged. The pack of black wolves that now threaten Springvale and Wolvendom are such creatures.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Investigate the core shrouded in Abyssal energy</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Dodge the attacks</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Interacting with the nearby core will attempt to Purify it.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Evil Eyes of the Blightseeper will appear nearby and shoot the player.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>As the player can not fight them back, these attacks must be dodged.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Before the player is overwhelmed, Illuga will appear for a brief dialogue and summon a shield.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>The voice from before returns, commanding the player to Purify the core.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>With the enemies purged by power of the voice, the player then chats about the situation with Illuga.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Follow Illuga to activate the barrier core</color>

<color=#ffffff73>As Illuga’s companion, Aedon, moves ahead, the shrouded path will be revealed.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Stand close by behind Illuga and copy his movements, as some moving platforms may be too fast.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Do note that falling off the platforms during this quest will have the player automatically teleport back to where they were.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Interact with the barrier core to Recharge it.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective</color> <color=#ffffff73>: Activate the barrier core on the other side</color>

<color=#ffffff73>Illuga will stay behind, but leave Aedon in your care to illuminate the path forward as you move.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Take the Moonlane back to the main platform for a shortcut.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>There are multiple moving platforms this time. Find the one that ascends in order to reach the barrier core.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Once more, interact with the barrier core to Recharge it.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>A cutscene will play, in which the player and Illuga meet with a woman named Alia.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Cleanse the corruption throughout the area and restore the barrier core (0/3)</color>

<color=#ffffff73>A new gauge called “Abyssal Corruption Level” will be featured in the top of the screen.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>In southeast area from the tower, the player will find two Abyss Mages, which must be defeated before the puzzle is revealed.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>To cleanse the Abyssal Riftlines, the player must employ the nearby Spirebloom plant in order to cut the lines.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Upon cleansing the abyssal</color> <color=#ffffff73>energies, the player will be ambushed by three waves of Abyss forces:</color>
<color=#ffffff73>First wave</color>
<color=#ffffff73>3x</color>

customize.name: Hilichurl Shooter
customize.desc:
The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.
Hilichurl archers who wield simple crossbows. Hilichurls do not, in truth, possess the craftsmanship needed to build crossbows. As such, it is commonly believed that there is an organization that controls the hilichurls from behind the scenes and furnishes them with equipment and material supplies. The Abyss Mages that often accompany these hilichurls are especially suspicious.

customize.text: <color=#ffffff73>1x</color>

customize.name: Hilichurl Grenadier
customize.desc:
The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.
These sneaky fellows are skilled in the use of Pyro Slimes, using them as weapons to attack intruders. Skilled grenadiers may be able to destroy four wooden dummies in a single throw.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff73>Second wave</color>
<color=#ffffff73>1x</color>

customize.name: Hydro Hilichurl Rogue
customize.desc:
Hilichurl wanderers unaffiliated with any specific tribe. They can often be found roving the wilds as if in voluntary exile.
They may also lend their aid to other hilichurls or hilichurl tribes for various reasons and go their separate ways afterward. They seem to possess a higher level of intelligence than commonplace hilichurls.

customize.text: <color=#ffffff73>2x</color>

customize.name: Pyro Hilichurl Shooter
customize.desc:
The primitive wandering inhabitants of Teyvat's wildernesses.
These archers wield simple crossbows, and their arrowheads are coated with a thin layer of flammable material that can set their targets on fire. El Musk of the previous generation believed that this is an innovation by brighter hilichurls who wished to cook their game after hunting it.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff73>Third wave</color>
<color=#ffffff73>2x</color>

customize.name: Fisher of Hidden Depths
customize.desc:
An Abyssal creature that slips through rifts in the hidden depths, crossing over from beyond this world.
Long ago, an ancient philosopher described humans as "featherless bipeds," using that simple phrase to distinguish mankind from animals and assert human superiority. In some sense, these deathless wanderers of the silent cosmic void, scaled instead of feathered, and using their hooked beaks to draw in biomass from world to world, might actually also match that same simplistic definition of "human."

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff73>Once all waves are defeated, the player must take the barrier core piece which was restrained by the Abyssal Riftline and reattach it to the barrier core in the same area.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>This can be done by interacting with the piece with your special skill and then aiming it at the barrier core.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Upon restoring one of these barrier cores, an Exquisite Chest will spawn nearby.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Cleanse the corruption throughout the area and restore the barrier core (1/3)</color>

<color=#ffffff73>At the eastern area from the tower, two pieces must be recovered.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>The first piece is contained by Abyssal Riftlines which can be cut with the nearby Spirebloom and once that is done, the player must attach it to the barrier core.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>This will trigger the appearance of an enemy wave:</color>
<color=#ffffff73>2x</color>

customize.name: Rockfond Rifthound
customize.desc:
A beast with monstrous blood that is capable of eroding the boundaries of the world. They were created by "Gold."
They do display certain biological behaviors similar to those of real wolves. Perhaps they feel jealousy towards these their "next of kin," and dream of replacing them someday.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff73>During the combat, the Spirebloom plant may end up Blighted, however, guiding a nearby Sheepsloth to it will restore it to a Suffused state.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>After cutting all Abyssal Riftlines that appear, attach the piece to its barrier core.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Additionally, attaching the last piece will cause an Exquisite Chest to spawn.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Cleanse the corruption throughout the area and restore the barrier core (2/3)</color>

<color=#ffffff73>To access the area in the northeast of the tower, the player must solve a puzzle at its entrance.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>This involves the nearby Solaris Core and Nycalyx mechanisms.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>First, place down the Miraculous Mandragora between the two crystals near the Solaris Core.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Afterwards, take the Glimmerfruit and walk near the Nycalyx.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>If everything is done right, kuuvahki energy will be seen connecting the Solaris Core to the Nycalyx, resulting in the cleansing of the Abyssal energies and opening the way forward.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Once the puzzle is solved, an Exquisite Chest will spawn by the entrance.</color>

<color=#ffffff73>After entering the northeast area, a new puzzle must be solved involving the Intricate Blooms mechanism.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>To solve it, take the Intricate Bloom and approach its energy core.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Once all energy lines appear connected, the puzzle will be solved, releasing both pieces.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Finally, take the two barrier core pieces and attach them to the barrier core in order to progress.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Head to the top of the tower</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Quest Objective:</color> <color=#ffffff73>Touch the core</color>

<color=#ffffff73>New moonlanes will appear as a shortcut to get the player to the top of the tower.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Upon getting at the top, the player must interact with the object to complete the quest and have another chat with Alia, acquiring the Silver Lampwick in the process.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Additionally, a Precious Chest will spawn nearby.</color>
